//regions: Run beside the database, not beside nothing in particular.
Singapore. With no region set, Vercel put the functions in iad1, Washington
DC, so every query went India → Virginia → Singapore → Virginia → India.
One query against a record that does not exist took 655ms warm; opening a
record runs five, which is where the six seconds came from.
sin1 is Singapore, so the function and the database are in the same place
and the only long hop left is the user's own, once, instead of once per query.
buildCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ]; then pnpm --filter @slk/db run db:migrate; fi && pnpm turbo run build --filter=@slk/web
